output.decision: Do not add another full tub of creatine. Add a practical, non-consumable creatine-use accessory—preferably a branded shaker bottle—on the third shipment, subject to unit economics and inventory. This avoids worsening the observed “too much product” cancellation reason while still making shipment three feel rewarded. Send an order-three-specific billing reminder that prominently mentions the gift, clearly states the upcoming charge, and offers an easy delay/skip path.
next_steps: Confirm a shaker bottle (or another durable, complementary accessory) meets margin, inventory, and shipping constraints.
Configure a third-shipment billing reminder with the gift message and dynamic charge date, price, and shipment details.
Add one-click delay/skip options; retain a clear subscription-management option without obscuring it.
Test reminder copy against the current reminder, measuring delays, cancellations, and gift-related support contacts.
missing_inputs: Available gift options, landed cost, inventory, and shipping impact.
Billing date, charge amount, shipment cadence, and available subscription actions.
Brand voice and any approved product-benefit claims.
Whether all third-shipment subscribers qualify or exclusions apply.

evidence_used.supports: Advises against gifting more of the subscribed product because excess supply can lead customers to delay or cancel; this directly matches the observed cancellation reason.
Recommends communicating an upcoming gift in order-number-specific billing reminders and offering delay options for customers with excess product.

assumptions: A shaker bottle is useful with creatine and does not materially create more product inventory for the customer.
The subscription platform can support order-number segmentation and delay/skip links.

Suggested reminder copy: “Your third creatine delivery is coming soon—and we’ve added a complimentary shaker bottle as a thank-you for staying consistent. Your subscription will renew on [date] for [amount]. Need a little more time before your next tub? Delay or skip this shipment here: [link]. View or adjust your subscription: [link].”
The source is unverified guidance; any compliance requirements and platform capabilities should be validated independently.
